def process(loadIdentityTheft) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = loadIdentityTheft.copy()
    col_area = 'Metropolitan Areas: Identity Theft Reports'
    col_reports = 'Unnamed: 1'

    # Keep only data rows: both area + report count present
    df = df[df[col_area].notna() & df[col_reports].notna()].copy()

    # Drop repeated headers / footer sources
    df = df[df[col_area].str.strip().ne('Metropolitan Area')]
    df = df[~df[col_area].str.startswith('Source:', na=False)]

    # Parse reports numeric (may contain commas)
    df['reportsIdentityTheft'] = (
        df[col_reports]
        .astype(str)
        .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
        .str.strip()
    )
    df['reportsIdentityTheft'] = pd.to_numeric(df['reportsIdentityTheft'], errors='coerce')

    out = df[['__source_file', col_area, 'reportsIdentityTheft']].rename(
        columns={col_area: 'metropolitanArea'}
    )

    # Some rows might still be non-numeric after coercion
    out = out[out['reportsIdentityTheft'].notna()].copy()

    # If the same metro appears multiple times within a file (unlikely), sum them.
    out = out.groupby(['__source_file', 'metropolitanArea'], as_index=False)['reportsIdentityTheft'].sum()
    return out

def process(loadFraudOther):
    import pandas as pd

    df = loadFraudOther.copy()
    area_col = 'Metropolitan Areas: Fraud and Other Reports'
    count_col = 'Unnamed: 1'

    df = df[df[area_col].notna() & df[count_col].notna()].copy()
    df[area_col] = df[area_col].astype(str).str.strip()

    # Drop repeated header row and footer/source rows
    df = df[df[area_col].str.lower() != 'metropolitan area']
    df = df[~df[area_col].str.lower().str.startswith('source:')]

    # Parse counts like '1,299'
    df['reportsFraudOther'] = (
        df[count_col]
        .astype(str)
        .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
        .str.strip()
    )
    df['reportsFraudOther'] = pd.to_numeric(df['reportsFraudOther'], errors='coerce')
    df = df[df['reportsFraudOther'].notna()].copy()

    df = df.rename(columns={area_col: 'metropolitanArea'})

    # Deduplicate within a file if any duplicates exist
    out = (
        df.groupby(['__source_file', 'metropolitanArea'], as_index=False)['reportsFraudOther']
        .sum()
    )
    return out

def process(cleanIdentityTheft, cleanFraudOther):
    import pandas as pd

    merged = cleanIdentityTheft.merge(
        cleanFraudOther,
        on=["__source_file", "metropolitanArea"],
        how="inner",
        validate="one_to_one",
    )
    merged["identityGtFraud"] = merged["reportsIdentityTheft"] > merged["reportsFraudOther"]
    exists = bool(merged["identityGtFraud"].any())
    return pd.DataFrame([{"existsMetroIdentityGtFraud": exists}])
